name: Dinesh Bajgain
tagline: Turning curiosity into code, one project at a time
bio: I'm a fresher developer from Nepal with a genuine passion for building things on the web and a growing curiosity for AI & Machine Learning. I enjoy turning ideas into real projects and love picking up new technologies along the way.
detailedBio: I've been sharpening my skills in full-stack development using React, Next.js, and Node.js, while dipping my toes into AI concepts like computer vision and chatbots. Every project I build teaches me something new, and I'm actively looking for opportunities to grow, contribute, and work alongside people I can learn from.
